# Define the source and destination directories
$sourceDir = "C:\Path\To\Source"
$backupDir = "D:\Backup"

# Get the current date and time in a format suitable for filenames
$dateString = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

# Create the backup directory with timestamped name if it doesn't exist
$timestampedBackupDir = Join-Path $backupDir "Backup_$dateString"
if (-Not (Test-Path $timestampedBackupDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $timestampedBackupDir | Out-Null
}

# Copy the contents of the source directory to the timestamped backup directory
Copy-Item -Path "$sourceDir\*" -Destination $timestampedBackupDir -Recurse

Write-Output "Backup completed successfully to $timestampedBackupDir"
